// Icon theme configuration

  home: Home,
  dashboard: Home,

  grid: Grid,

  calendarDays: CalendarDays,
  
  // Utilities
  externalLink: ExternalLink,
  share: Share2,
  zap: Zap,
  shield: Shield,
  key: Key
};

// Icon component with consistent styling
export const Icon = ({ 
  name, 
  size = 20, 
  color = 'currentColor', 
  className = '',
  style = {},
  ...props 
}) => {
  const IconComponent = IconTheme[name];
  
  if (!IconComponent) {
    console.warn(`Icon "${name}" not found in IconTheme`);
    return null;
  }
  
  return (
    <IconComponent
      size={size}
      color={color}
      className={className}
      style={{
        flexShrink: 0,
        ...style
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
};

// Common icon sizes
export const IconSizes = {
  xs: 16,
  sm: 20,
  md: 24,
  lg: 32,
  xl: 48,
  xxl: 64
};

// Common icon colors based on your theme
export const IconColors = {
  primary: 'var(--primary-blue)',
  secondary: 'var(--secondary-blue)',
  success: 'var(--success)',
  warning: 'var(--warning)',
  danger: 'var(--danger)',
  info: 'var(--info)',
  white: '#FFFFFF',
  gray: 'var(--gray-500)',
  dark: 'var(--gray-800)',
  light: 'var(--gray-300)'
};

export default Icon;
